plugins.description: Social-media data for AI agents via tikin. Download media and fetch posts, profiles, comments, search results, trends, and analytics across TikTok, Douyin, Instagram, YouTube, Twitter/X, Threads, Xiaohongshu, and more through tikin's unified REST API using your own tikin API key.
